definitions.explanation: A counter for cups, glasses, bowls, and spoonfuls of liquid or food served in such containers.

examples.japanese: コーヒーを{一|いっ}{杯|ぱい}ください。
examples.notes: いっぱい with small っ and ぱ

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{水|みず}を{二|に}{杯|はい}{飲|の}みます。
examples.english: I drink two glasses of water every morning.

examples.japanese: ラーメンを{三|さん}{杯|ばい}{食|た}べました。
examples.english: I ate three bowls of ramen.
examples.notes: さんばい with voiced ば

notes: {杯|はい} has variable pronunciation: {一|いっ}{杯|ぱい}, {二|に}{杯|はい}, {三|さん}{杯|ばい}, {四|よん}{杯|はい}, {五|ご}{杯|はい}, {六|ろっ}{杯|ぱい}, {七|なな}{杯|はい}, {八|はっ}{杯|ぱい}, {九|きゅう}{杯|はい}, {十|じゅっ}{杯|ぱい}. The pronunciation changes between はい, ぱい, and ばい depending on the number.
